primary_suppression_method: complete DA sum; if any member DA LIM count missing, unweighted median of all complete positive-population CT LIM/all-population ratios in same CSD times suppressed CT population
sensitivity_method: unweighted mean of same complete municipal CT ratios
source_preservation: Suppressed source cells remain blank; only analysis counts are constructed
scope: resident concentration around road proxy, not official prevalence or benefit distribution
